summary: Smithfield Foods filed an 8-K on its entry into a $600 million senior unsecured delayed draw term loan facility, agented by Bank of America, available in a single drawing through December 23, 2026 and maturing three years after funding. Proceeds are earmarked partly to redeem all outstanding 4.250% Senior Notes due 2027 at 100.000% of principal plus accrued interest, on or after November 1, 2026. Pricing floats at SOFR or base rate plus a rating-based spread grid. The filing is a financing and refinancing event rather than a transactional special situation; watch liability-management timing and leverage impact.
